scope: Exploratory CPU scoring on selected 10-second excerpts and constructed controls; no human perceptual labels and no new RL training.

audiobox.hardware: Apple M4 Mac mini, 24 GiB unified memory, macOS arm64
audiobox.timing_scope: Four CPU threads, sequential batch-one files. Model initialization excludes Python imports and downloads; per-file scoring excludes file decoding, includes model preprocessing/forward, output serialization preparation and SHA256. PAM includes two overlapping 7s windows plus cached custom text prompts and embedding write. No concurrent scorer process, no GPU/MPS. OS weight pages may already be cached.
